reviews.rationale: The dated April benchmark reports substantial functional success alongside much weaker security performance, supporting the modest qualitative comparison. Its vendor provenance and lack of independent replication limit generalization. The packet establishes neither population-wide vulnerability rates nor next-word prediction as the cause; feedback-assisted repair does not negate the observed gap.
